# `part.assign`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/part.assign.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`part.assign` (`AssignPart`, WP-S1.19 D8, FT-168): assigns a part to devices in one undo step, embedding the
library copies it needs (D7: the command carries the documents, never reads a library).

Each document of `copies` (the `lib/` JSON form, the part's closure as the caller resolved it) is checked as
`library.embed` checks it, at `/copies/i`; a copy the project holds with the same hash is reused (not inserted
again), one it holds with another hash (another version of the item) is refused: "update from library first"
(`library.update`, FR-PRT-014). The others are inserted. Then each device's part uses change by `mode`:
- `append` (the default): a part use `{part, qty}` is added after the existing ones;
- `replace_all`: the part uses become the one `{part, qty}`;
- `replace`: every part use of the copy `from` becomes `{part, qty}` (without `qty`: the replaced use's
  quantity); the variant is dropped. A device without a part use of `from` is refused.

A placement of a device whose part copy leaves the device follows the one copy the command adds, in the same
transaction (modes `replace` and `replace_all` when the device did not use the part before; WP-S4.01 D7,
FR-LAY-007). Otherwise it stays and EW-LAY-003 reports it: a mode that only removes the placed copy (the part was
already used) is a removal, not a replacement (FR-LAY-059); `append` removes no copy; a placement that names no
part (the primary) has nothing to follow.

`qty` defaults to 1. Template functions are not matched onto existing functions (D8: part-first placement
does that). Rejected, with the pointer: an empty device list (`/devices`), a device listed twice or that does
not exist (`/devices/i`), `part` neither held nor in `copies` (`/part`), a copy listed twice or held at another
version (`/copies/i`), `replace` without `from` and `from` with another mode (`/from`), a device that does not
use `from` (`/devices/i`), `qty` ≤ 0 (`/qty`). Cost: `Interactive` below 50 devices, `Bulk` from 50
(`ASSIGN_BULK_FROM`). Outcome: the first device.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `copies` | array of any JSON value | no |  | The library documents to embed (`lib/` JSON form): the part and its closure; may be empty when the project holds them. |
| `devices` | array of [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | The devices, at least one. |
| `from` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) or `null` | no |  | The copy ID of the part to replace; with mode `replace` only. |
| `mode` | [`AssignModeParam`](#assignmodeparam) | no |  | How the part uses change; default `append`. |
| `part` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | The part's copy ID, `v5(NS_LIBCOPY, library ‖ item)`: held by the project or in `copies`. |
| `qty` | [`CmdDec3`](#cmddec3) or `null` | no |  | The quantity in the part's order unit; default 1 (`replace`: the replaced use's quantity). |

## Types

### AssignModeParam

How `part.assign` changes a device's part uses (FR-PRT-023).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"append"` | Adds a part use after the device's existing ones (the default). |
| `"replace_all"` | Replaces every part use of the device by the one part use. |
| `"replace"` | Replaces each part use of the copy `from` by the part (a device that does not use `from` is refused). |

### CmdDec3

A canonical decimal string with at most three fraction digits, no trailing fraction zeros and no unit (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at most 21 character(s))

Pattern: `^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]{0,15}(?:\.[0-9]{0,2}[1-9])?|-?0\.[0-9]{0,2}[1-9])$`

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
